title: What's new
subtitle: The latest improvements to the app.

assistant-history-purged.title: Older assistant conversations deleted
assistant-history-purged.body: As part of tightening how candidate data is deleted, your conversations with the assistant from before this update have been deleted. From now on, deleting a candidate also deletes every conversation in which the assistant read their data.

delete-organization.title: Delete an organization
delete-organization.body: An organization's owner can now delete it from its settings, after typing its name to confirm. Every role, candidate recording, CV, transcript, report and assistant conversation in it is erased for good, and its members are told by email. Being the only owner of an organization no longer stands between you and deleting your account: delete the organization first, and your account is free to go.

clearer-account-settings.title: Clearer account settings
clearer-account-settings.body: Your profile now follows an email change step by step, shows the ways you can really sign in, and lets you set a password if your account has none. An account-deletion link opened on another device now leads to a clear page, and an account can no longer leave an organization without an owner. We also hardened our security notices: you now get an email after a password reset too.

sign-in-with-a-code.title: Sign in with a code from your email
sign-in-with-a-code.body: Enter your email and we send you a 6-digit code — or a button that fills it in for you. The same steps create your account, so there is no password to choose; you can still sign in with one if you have it. Invitations use the same sign-in, and a session that expires now brings you back to the page you were on.

verification-link-guidance.title: Clearer email verification
verification-link-guidance.body: Opening a verification link while signed in to another account, or after it has expired, now tells you what to do next instead of leaving you on a plain sign-in page. Sign-up also asks you to type your password twice.

team-invitations.title: Smoother team invitations
team-invitations.body: Invite several teammates at once, see who invited whom and when, resend an invitation or copy its link, and spot an email that bounced. Expired invitations are marked as such and can be sent again. People who sign up without the link now see the invitation waiting for them instead of creating a second organization, and anyone can create another organization from the organization menu. The invitation email now says which role you are offered and until when.

sturdier-interview.title: A sturdier interview for your candidates
sturdier-interview.body: Candidates now see themselves while they record, can carry on with audio alone when their camera is taken by another app, watch their answers upload, and see what is missing before they finish. The interview speaks your role's language whatever their browser's, and they get an email when it reaches you — with a link to see or delete their data. We also hardened how their interview links are handled in our error monitoring.

verification-needs-password.title: Confirming your email now asks for your password
verification-needs-password.body: We strengthened email verification: after clicking the link, you now sign in with your password to confirm your address. That way a verification link can only ever complete an account you set up yourself.

job-import-pinned.title: Job-ad import, hardened
job-import-pinned.body: We hardened how job-ad imports reach the web: each page is now fetched only from the address we checked.

erasure-reaches-copies.title: Deleting a candidate reaches every copy
erasure-reaches-copies.body: We hardened candidate data deletion: when a candidate’s data is erased, the copies kept by our email and assistant services go too — assistant conversations that read it immediately, email copies automatically within 30 days at most.

candidate-interview-hardening.title: A closed interview stays closed, and a deletion is complete
candidate-interview-hardening.body: We hardened the candidate interview. A cancelled or closed invitation now stays closed at every step, including the last one. The delivery figures in a report are now computed only from what our own systems measured. And deleting a candidate’s data now removes every recording they made, including an answer re-recorded from another browser.

team-access-hardening.title: Confidential roles stay confidential, and removal ends access
team-access-hardening.body: We tightened who can see and act on confidential roles, and made sure that removing a teammate fully ends their access to your organisation — including the emails they receive about candidates. Restoring an archived role now takes the same rights as archiving it.

assistant-images-and-role-actions.title: Safer assistant replies, clearer role actions
assistant-images-and-role-actions.body: We hardened the assistant: images in its replies are no longer loaded, only described. And a role’s Share, Archive and Restore actions are now offered only to the people who can use them.

abuse-hardening.title: Hardened against misuse
abuse-hardening.body: We hardened the AI assistant, job-ad import, account notifications and shared report links against misuse, so they stay fast and fair for everyone.

assistant-in-europe.title: The assistant runs in Europe too
assistant-in-europe.body: The assistant that answers your questions about roles and candidates now runs on the same French provider as interview transcription and assessment. It reads reports in order to answer you, so what you ask it about a candidate is interview data like any other — and it belongs under the same guarantee: one provider, one destination, and nothing about a candidate leaving it.

role-authoring-fixes.title: Adding questions, and importing ads that are not plain pages
role-authoring-fixes.body: Two fixes to building a role. “Add a question” now opens an editable card instead of refusing with “a question must contain text” before you had a chance to type any. And importing from a job ad works on boards that render their ads in the browser — Welcome to the Jungle, Indeed, ATS career pages — which previously came back as “not enough text on that page”. When a site refuses to be read by anything but a browser, the app now says that, rather than suggesting your link is wrong.

european-ai.title: Interview analysis now runs in Europe
european-ai.body: Transcription and assessment both run on Mistral, a French provider, on European infrastructure. The assessment step used to pass through a router that picked a provider by price; we constrained it, but the guarantee rested on a setting rather than on where the request actually went. There is now one provider and one destination, and a candidate's interview does not leave it.

reliable-reports.title: Reports you can rely on
reliable-reports.body: An interview where one answer fails to transcribe now still produces a report, from the answers that worked, and says on its face that it is missing one — instead of silently producing nothing at all. A quote that cannot be matched against the recording is shown without a play button rather than sent to an approximate moment: if we cannot prove where something was said, we do not pretend to. We have also hardened how share links expire, what leaves our infrastructure, and how completely a deletion deletes.

report-sharing.title: Share a report by link
report-sharing.body: Send one report to a hiring manager without giving them an account. Links expire on a schedule you choose and can be revoked at any time. They show the assessment and the recordings behind it — never your private notes or the candidate’s documents.

async-interviews.title: Asynchronous video interviews
async-interviews.body: Create a role, record your questions on camera, and invite candidates by email. They answer from their browser whenever suits them, and you get a report scored against the criteria you set — with every claim linked to the moment in the video that backs it.
